I'm identifying the diagonal 4-pattern in the template box, then scanning the grid for other matching diagonal pairs of 4s to enclose with a border of 1s, clipped at the grid edges.

I found three matches: (9,18)-(10,19), (14,18)-(15,19), and (20,13)-(21,14). Now I'm working out each box's boundary by extending one row/column beyond the 4s in each direction, same as the template's dimensions.

Applying the template's interior pattern to region1 gives (9,19)=1 and (10,18)=1. Checking regions 2 and 3 for conflicts with existing 4s shows they're clean, and row 22 columns 12-15 need to be filled with 1s. Now I'm assembling the final grid with all three boxes placed.
